name: websign-extension
description: WebeSign browser extension: the bridge between pages using @websign/sdk and the WebeSign app (native messaging). No UI besides the toolbar popup.

scripts.build: wxt build -b chrome && wxt build -b edge && wxt build -b firefox --mv3 && wxt build -b safari
scripts.zip: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b edge && wxt zip -b firefox --mv3 && wxt zip -b safari
scripts.zip:store: WEBSIGN_CHANNEL=store wxt zip -b chrome && WEBSIGN_CHANNEL=store wxt zip -b edge && WEBSIGN_CHANNEL=store wxt zip -b firefox --mv3
